tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Geolocation, network (ISP, ASN), risk score with its main reason (risk_reason) and, from Pro, the full breakdown of the score (risk_signals) and the security flags for ONE public IPv4 or IPv6 address. Counts one lookup against the key's monthly quota.

tools.name: bulk_lookup
tools.description: Geolocation, network and risk data (the score with its main reason on every plan; the full breakdown and security flags from Pro) for SEVERAL IP addresses in one call. tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: The API key's plan, the lookups used and left this lookup month (single lookups plus bulk IPs), when the month resets, and the rate limit. Does not count as a lookup.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
